style.look: Photorealistic live-action Chinese period drama, 35mm film, fine grain, natural skin texture, real-world photography, shallow depth of field, grounded historical realism — not anime, not cartoon, not illustration, not cel shading, not an advertisement, not slow motion, no on-screen text
style.palace_palette: deep crimson, black and gold; silk sheen, embroidered surfaces, jewellery that catches light
style.market_palette: grey-blue, rice white and ochre; patched cloth with small embroidered flowers, clean but worn
style.crossing_rule: the two palettes never collide except in the exchange scenes, where one garment is worn by the other woman
style.motif: two identical faces; a gold crown shaped like cat ears; the grey-white Persian cat sits on the central axis of almost every shot
